notes.title: New sound system
notes.content:
Happy New Year! 

New sound system update
- Spatial and directional improvement
- Add reverb

Some bug fixes
- Start position bug when using Oculus device
- Some movement bugs

notes.title: Movement option have been added.
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33947742/17ac07b72f586b1065fcfb3e7ab100c7fb200a57.jpg

- Update
Arm swing, Teleport, Free move options have been added.
All three modes are controlled by the touchpad.
You can change the locomotion by using the above picture book.


- Fixed some bugs

notes.title: (Experimental) Spectator View
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33947742/e307388b5f6e8583a54826b23dd4fd74674c8ab2.jpg
For third person view.
The person wearing the HMD can see well.
It does not look neat to the viewer.

If you have viewers, try using Spectator View.
- High quality screen
- Auto zoom in, zoom out
- Smooth camera movement

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33947742/13aa76a969eb59c07b809ba82c32c87942c44e10.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33947742/7b49733dd1e69599fc09adb7eaa8e791a6c071b4.jpg

But you need a high spec computer.
And some functions do not work when Spectator View.
Fade in, fade out, screen shake, and more ..

Please use it and give us your feedback.
